# CipherFS

Client-encrypted files with automatic storage and reliable synchronization.

Homepage: https://cipherfs.com

## Install

Choose a formula from the table and run its complete command. This third-party
tap ships prebuilt binaries for Apple Silicon and Intel macOS, plus ARM64 and
Intel Linux.

| Formula | Install command | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [cipherfs](Formula/cipherfs.rb) | `brew install cipherfs/tap/cipherfs` | Encrypted vault with sync, serving and filesystem mounting |
